Messages.Author: Jadasc
Messages.Body: Is the title meant to be "Pacifism," or is there something about being passive that I'm missing?

Messages.Author: AaronC
Messages.Body:
"Passivism" means a passive approach to something or life in general.

"Pacifism" means that you oppose the use of physical force, particularly in the context of the military. Pacifism does not imply passivism: pacifists may be very active in protesting wars and such.

Messages.Author: Maddog
Messages.Body:
> Zenedar wrote:
> Why over powered? Looks like a weak card to me. Can't be used against immortal grapple and it doesn't do anything against animalism combat or guns so basicly it's useful against ally combat? Combat ends seems better in that case anyway.
>
Player 1 plays torn sign post, + octopod + undead strength vs Player 2 playing Passivism which protects against a pretty big hit + additional hits and costs nothing.

Player 1 hits for hands for 1 agg vs player 2 playing Passivism, being completely immune from any hand strikes and additional hand strikes this round without a cost is to unbalanced.

Even "Rigor Mortis" at inferior presence cost 1 blood for the same additional strikes denial "The opposing minion cannot use any additional strikes this round (cost 1 blood)

Presence already has multiple strike combat ends cards, Unholy Penance, Toreador's Bane, Putrefaction, Majesty, Force of Personality and Catatonic Fear.I don't think it needs any more variations.

I think there are other disciplines/clans in this game that need strengthening before we continue to buff a good solid strong discipline such as presence.
